Heavy rainfall leads to multiple wastewater bypasses across the state

Thursday, October 1, 2026
News Release
Image

STATEWIDE -- Several communities have notified DNR Field Offices of flooding impacts and wastewater bypasses. Bypassing can lower the water level in the collection system. It is recommended people and pets avoid these areas and stay out of flooded waterways.

EXAMPLE COUNTY – A stockpile of pressed wastewater sludge (biosolids) became saturated near a farm northeast of the City of Sampleton, causing a runoff event into a drainage ditch, which outlets to Fixture Creek. As a precaution, the public is advised to avoid Fixture Creek north of Sampleton at this time.
